background.description: White paper, black ink, running/cursive handwriting (not block, capital, or disjointed letters)

notes: RRB NTPC's own 2026-27 CEN had not been released as of this verification (expected around October/November 2026, per RRB's public announcements) — this preset is cross-referenced from the most recent verified RRB notification, CEN 09/2025 (Level-1/Group D), which specifies: signature scanned at minimum 100 DPI, JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, minimum 140x60 pixels, black ink, running/cursive handwriting only (no block/capital/disjointed letters). RRB's recent CENs also no longer require a pre-made photo upload — the application captures a live photograph via webcam/mobile camera during form-filling instead, so there is no rrb-ntpc-photo preset. Re-verify all of this against the actual NTPC CEN once it's published, since this is inferred from a related exam's notification, not NTPC's own.
